anthropic.name: Anthrophic
anthropic.description: Provides access to the Claude family of models
anthropic.content: [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/) provides access to the Claude family of models. You can connect to Anthropic via [proxy inference](/docs/quickstart) or by using your own API key with a third party harness like [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) and the [Compeer CLI](/docs/cli).

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.content: [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) is Anthropic's agentic coding assistant. Use the [Compeer CLI](/docs/cli) to initialize Compeer in your project, pick a workspace, and select Claude Code as your harness. Now, Claude Code can search context stored in Compeer. You can also integrate Compeer via [mcp](/docs/mcp-servers).
